children: QVC Group filed a Chapter 11 monthly operating report showing an August 5, 2026 cash balance of $205.4 million and total liabilities of $7.891 billion.
Filed Monthly Operating Report for period Aug 1–5, 2026; report furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to 8-K.
Cash balance end of month reported at $205,415,675, up from a beginning balance of $200,583,555.
Total postpetition debt reported $303.4M; prepetition secured debt $5.046B and prepetition unsecured debt $2.537B.
Total liabilities (postpetition + prepetition) reported at $7,891,414,791, resulting in ending equity/net worth of -$5.839B.
Company cautions MOR figures are unaudited, prepared for bankruptcy compliance, and subject to adjustment; not to be relied on for investment decisions.
